Data in this browser

Export settings and drafts for another browser. Messages are not included.

How your data works

Your account and messages are stored on the server. Your password is stored as a hash. Themes, drafts, and local settings stay in this browser unless you export or clear them.

Deleted messages disappear from chat but remain in the staff log, including their text, media link, sender, time, and who deleted them. Purging a channel also keeps its messages in that log.

Members cannot see or search deleted messages. Staff can view them for moderation.

Deleting your account removes your login and profile. Your messages remain in channels and DMs under your username. Signing out ends only this session.

Delete account

Your login and profile are removed. Messages you sent remain in their conversations.

Changes save automatically.

Liminal Rules

Rule #1

No inappropriate media, GIFs, or music. Text is fine as long as it isn't explicit.

Rule #2

No harmful, hateful, or illegal content or jokes. This includes, but is not limited to: CSAM, zoophilia, necrophilia, pedophilia, sexism, explicit racism, and sexualizing minors.

Rule #3

No threats or bullying. Jokes are fine until they reach the point where the receiver is under stress.

Rule #4

No blackmail.

Rule #5

No griefing the doc or chat. Staff abuse is not tolerated, even if you paid to be an admin.

Rule #6

Use common sense. Staff can act on behavior not listed here.
